machine: 8 cores / 16GB, macOS, herdr worktree hp-pacman-t-0067-e2e-ci-693, pnpm cold install
ambient: multi-lane dev machine: other lanes' node/vite/chromium load varies run to run (load average ~19 during the last run); family-delta numbers carry that noise, tree-scoped numbers do not

methods.wall: /usr/bin/time real seconds, whole command incl. webServer startup
methods.tree_memory: 1s sampler walking the ppid tree from the run's root PID: descendant count + summed RSS (playwright driver + vite build/preview + chromium workers, neighbors excluded)
methods.family_memory: 1s sampler of the machine-wide node/vite/chromium/playwright family; delta = in-run peak minus pre-run floor (used for the full-suite run only — re-running the full suite a second time just to re-scope the sampler was ruled out by the one-measurement discipline)

full_e2e.note: playwright default workers = 4 on this machine

fixture_build_alone.note: vite build --mode fixture, fresh outDir: 788ms build; the build is not the cost, the 617-test run is

affected.demo: pnpm --filter @pacman/web e2e:affected -- apps/web/src/chief/chief-drawer.tsx -> chief family: 6 specs / 49 tests, all green on every run

runs.note: load average ~19 during this run (contended); serial ideal is ~35s, quiet-machine estimate ~25-30s

criterion_693_ac1.ask: one command for change-related e2e, time AND memory under 1/5 of baseline
criterion_693_ac1.time: met in the 4-worker configuration: 22.45/154.3 = 14.5%; at the shipped 2-worker default ~19% on a quiet machine (64s = 42% measured under load-19 contention)
criterion_693_ac1.memory: not reachable for any real browser e2e: one chromium + playwright driver + vite server is a ~1.0-1.4GB floor, i.e. ~40% of the 3.4GB full-suite peak. What does drop: instantaneous peak 2.4x (2.74GB -> 1.40GB with 2 workers) and the pressure integral (peak x duration) roughly 8-12x, which is the quantity that actually protects a 16GB machine with parallel lanes

vitest_affected_surface.related: verified: pnpm exec vitest related apps/web/src/board/dnd.ts at repo root -> exactly dnd.test.ts (7 tests, 2.1s), cross-project
